title: Naval Intelligence as a major funder of Puharich

tellings.quote: cuz we know we know Naval Intelligence at one point uh was like a big funder of Puharich, not not only back in the '50s, but going into um the early '80s as well.

plain: Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's intelligence service, was at one point a big funder of Andrija Puharich, a doctor who researched psychic phenomena, from the 1950s right into the early 1980s. A researcher named Greg Malatzi says this as something "we know", without naming a source. If true, it would mean the Navy was paying for decades of research into the paranormal.
